reviewedBy: Agent that authored neither af nor tl bank packs
method: Read every132template prompt, both hints and explanation for each target (528fields per locale), plus3text labels. Compared mathematical intent to English reference and entire Korean canonical pack. Field reasons identify assessed quantities/operations and translation-specific or inherited-source concerns. Symbolic comparison is supplemental, not a substitute for semantic judgment.
limitations: Independent AI review only; not native-speaker or teacher review.
No generated concrete question instances, generator parameter ranges, rendered UI, answer parser or runtime assessment behavior were reviewed.
Some target-language terminology is marked unsure; pass means no semantic mismatch identified at this review, not certified idiomatic/native quality.
All proposed patches are suggestions only; target and source files were not modified.
genderReview: Only generic symbolic groups of people occur in combNC/permNP and pieCount; no named human characters or gender assignment introduced. Afrikaans object-pronouns sy/homself refer to numbers/shapes and are not human gender evidence. Tagalog pronouns do not infer gender. Canonical unknowns retained.

sourceIssues.source: Rounding up always raises it, rounding down always drops it, and rounding to the nearest raises it only when the digit is 5 or more.

sourceIssues.reason: Always raises is false for an exact multiple under ordinary ceiling/rounding-up conventions. No runtime boundary cases were examined.
sourceIssues.proposedEnglishPatch: Round up if discarded digits are nonzero; round down by discarding lower places; round to nearest by checking whether the next digit is 5 or more.
